definition.def: A region is a large area of land that is different from other areas of land, for example because it is one of the different parts of a country with its own customs and characteristics, or because it has a particular geographical feature.
The regions are the parts of a country that are not the capital city and its surrounding area. [British]
examples: Tax incentives would be used to attract firms to the regions, away from the capital.

definition.def: You can refer to a part of your body as a region.
You say in the region of to indicate that an amount that you are stating is approximate. [vagueness]
examples: The scheme will cost in the region of six million pounds.
